title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on When the Limitation Period Begins for a Debtor Who Issues an IOU Without a Repayment Date After Failing to Perform the Debt Within the Agreed Period

articles.content_en:
Higher People's Court of Shandong Province:
Your court's Request No. Lu Gao Fa [1992] 70 has been received. Concerning the issue of when the limitation of action period shall begin to run where the debtor, after failing to perform the debt upon expiration of the agreed period, issues an IOU without a repayment date, upon study, we reply as follows:
According to your court's report, both parties originally agreed that after the supplier delivered the goods, the buyer shall pay immediately. After receiving the goods, because the buyer had no funds to pay, with the supplier's consent, it wrote an IOU without a repayment date. According to the provisions of Article 195 of the Civil Code, it shall be determined that the limitation of action is interrupted. If the supplier has not claimed its rights after the interruption of the limitation of action, the limitation of action period shall be recalculated from the date on which the supplier received the IOU written by the buyer.
This is the reply.
